title: How2Everything: Mining the Web for How-To Procedures to Evaluate and Improve LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting a cross-judge robustness check by rescoring the same model generations using different LLM judges (e.g., GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude 4.5 Opus) to evaluate if judges systematically favor outputs from their own model families.

Performing an instance-level logistic regression analysis to measure the correlation between the generation-to-reference length ratio and the LLM judge's success rate, verifying if longer procedural outputs are unfairly rewarded.
